items.title: Jon Hendricks — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: When I heard Moody’s Mood for Love, I said, that’s the answer. I was inspired by that song.

ctx.x: Yeah. I had been thinking about it, because I could sing the whole arrangement. I knew all the solos and all of the – the whole arrangement. I used to sing it to myself. When I heard Moody’s Mood for Love, I said, that’s the answer. I don’t have to stop at 8 bars, or I don’t have to stop at 32 bars. I can go on and on and on and on. That’s when I did that. I was inspired by that song.
So what did this really do for your concept of music from that point on?
